question: Through which of the following organisations did Annie Besant promote the studies of ancient Indian religions, philosophies and doctrines?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Theosophical Society.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Annie Besant** was a **British socialist, women's rights activist, and theosophist **who played a significant role in India's struggle for independence from British rule.
 
• She promoted the studies of **ancient Indian religions, philosophies, and doctrines** through the Theosophical Society.
 
• Annie Besant became the **President** of the **Theosophical Society in 1907,** which was founded in **New York in 1875.**
 
• The Theosophical Society aimed to promote the study of **comparative religion, philosophy, and science, **and to investigate the unexplained laws of nature and the powers latent in humanity.
 
• Besant believed that ancient **Indian wisdom** had much to offer the world, and she worked tirelessly to promote the **study of Hinduism, Buddhism,** and other **Eastern religions** through the Theosophical Society.
 
• She also co-authored a book called **'The Secret Doctrine'** with the founder of **Theosophical Society, Madame Blavatsky, **which explored the origins of the universe and humanity's place in it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Arya Samaj**

 
 
• Arya Samaj was founded by **Swami Dayanand Saraswati** in **1875 in Bombay.**
 
• It aimed to promote the **study of the Vedas **and to **reform Hinduism** by rejecting **idol worship and caste system.**
 
• Although Arya Samaj promoted the study of ancient Indian religions, it **did not **have a significant influence on Annie Besant's work.
 
 
 
• 
 **Paramhans Mandali **

 
 
• Paramhans Mandali was a religious and social reform organization** founded by Dadoba Pandurang in 1840 in Bombay (now Mumbai).**
 
• It aimed at abolishing caste distinctions and promoting social equality.
 
• Advocated for the study and interpretation of Vedanta philosophy.
 
• Emphasized rational thinking and education..
 
 
 
• **Prarthana Samaj**
 
 
• Prarthana Samaj was founded by **Atmaram Pandurang** in **1867 in Bombay.**
 
• It aimed to promote monotheism and to reform Hinduism by** rejecting idol worship, caste system, and untouchability.**
 
• Although Prarthana Samaj promoted the study of ancient Indian religions, it **did not **have a significant influence on Annie Besant's work.
